name: com.thingctx/thingctx
description: Drive any agent against any W3C WoT Thing from its description. The agent never holds your keys; you gate what it is allowed to do.

packageArguments.description: A TD Directory URL, a folder of Thing Descriptions, or a TD file. Defaults to the curated thingctx registry.

environmentVariables.name: THINGCTX_POLICY
environmentVariables.description: What the agent may do: read-only | no-writes | full.

environmentVariables.name: THINGCTX_APPROVE_WHEN
environmentVariables.description: When the agent asks before acting: declared | destructive | all | never.
